regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate transformation claim were inspected. The source says SI is available online, but source_mapping.json leaves SI association unestablished and no SI facts were used.

The original image shows a generic C-H functionalization/coupling overview with cited arylation/halogenation/amination/oxygenation and insertion classes plus a generic allene coupling-cyclization concept. It is classified as general_scheme, not experiment-specific arrows.

unresolved: Scheme 1 has generic R groups, directing groups, metals, and partners and therefore does not support unique structures, quantities, or outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 upper half Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1-11, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Eleven distinct solvent/additive/catalyst optimization rows were retained with shared substrate scale, row times, NMR 3aa yields, 2a recoveries/source dashes, catalyst overrides, Cu(OAc)2 15 mol% footnote, solvent ratio, and the unidentified-minor-product footnote. Table 1 entry 8 is cross-merged with identical Table 2 entry 1.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left and lower-right optimization narrative
regions.finding: The prose confirms individual Table 1 outcomes and introduces Table 2 ligand effects. It was linked to the row records rather than counted as duplicate experiments.

unresolved: Optimization rows omit workup, purification, and isolated product masses; nonstandard solvent volumes are not explicitly printed.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1-7, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Seven ligand/metal conditions were accounted for. Entry 1 is merged with Table 1 entry 8; entries 2-7 remain separate, including the RhCl3 no-product/97% recovery row, NaHCO3 footnote, ligand-loading variants, recovery footnotes, and the 1.0-equivalent 1a override.

regions.region: page 3 center and lower Table 3 reaction drawing, rows 1-14, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Fourteen distinct scope experiments were retained row-by-row with exact shared quantities, times, isolated yields, entry-4 dr, entry-5 1.16-equivalent 2e override, entry-6/7 10 °C override, and the distinct 10 mmol/2.20 g scale-up in entry 14.

unresolved: Table 2 omits reaction times and absolute scales; Table 3 omits workups, purification, and isolated masses.
Complex product structures and stereochemistry remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left scope discussion and Figure 1 ORTEP
regions.finding: The text confirms Table 3 substituent tolerance and distinct 10 mmol scale-up. The ORTEP of 3ae supports identity but is characterization, not another preparation and does not mark the machine structure verified.
A separate naphthyl experiment was retained: 1g and 2b under standard conditions at 25 °C in air for 48 h give 3gb in 71%, exclusively from naphthalene C2 rather than C8.
Four possible pathways A-D through M1-M4 are explicitly proposed and continue visually as Scheme 2 on page 5; they are represented by one mechanism record, not observed intermediate experiments.

regions.region: page 4 right-column mechanistic controls and Table 4 introduction
regions.finding: The prose reports the KIE probes, two catalyst-loading cycloisomerizations, failed 4b-plus-1a coupling, and four chiral-allene reactions. These were reconciled with the arrows/tables on pages 5-6 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Figure 1 is structure support only; no crystallographic facts were promoted to verified reaction structures.
Several mechanistic-control experiments omit scale, workup, purification, and yield bases.

regions.finding: The original image shows proposed paths A-D through M1-M4, 4b, Rh(I)/Rh(III), and O2. The diagram is classified as mechanism and is not decomposed into preparative experiments.
Two separate KIE experiments were retained: 1a-D/2b gives 3ab-D in 74% with kH/kD=4/1 after 25 h, while 1a-D5/1a/2b gives a 70% deuterated-product mixture with kH/kD=5/1 after 25 h.

regions.region: page 5 lower equation (4) and adjacent text
regions.finding: A nitrogen-atmosphere control was retained separately: after 27 h, 3ab and 4b are each reported at 8% with 69% recovery of 2b, supporting air/O2 as oxidant.

unresolved: KIE schemes omit absolute scales, workups, purification, isolated masses, and yield bases; isotopologue structures remain label-only.
Equation (4) does not report the analytical basis for yields/recovery.

regions.finding: Three distinct controls were retained: 2b with 2.5 mol% catalyst gives 4b 10% and 76% 2b recovery after 25 h; 50 mol% catalyst gives 4b 88% after 23 h; isolated 4b plus 1a does not form 3ab and gives 73% 4b recovery.

regions.region: page 6 center-left precursor route above Table 4
regions.finding: The displayed CuBr/N-PINAP/ZnI2/NaI preparation of R-2b or S-2b is explicitly tied to reference 12 and is classified as a literature method, not a newly quantified current-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 6 center and lower Table 4 reaction drawing and rows 1-4
regions.finding: Four axial-to-central chirality-transfer experiments were retained separately with 95% ee R-2b or S-2b, row times, product yields, product ee values, and standard Rh/NaOAc/C5H2Me4/MeOH-H2O/air conditions.
The conclusion summarizes the favored C-H rhodation/cyclic oxyrhodation/reductive-elimination pathway and O2 reoxidation; it adds no distinct experiment beyond Scheme 2/3 and equation (4).

unresolved: Scheme 3 controls omit scale and most operational details; the high-catalyst yield basis and failed-coupling time are missing.
Table 4 omits scale, workup, purification, isolated masses, yield basis, and ee measurement methods.
No SI facts were used or inferred.
